por-larranaga-cuba--linea-clasica.description: Founded in 1834, Por Larrañaga draws its wrapper and filler from the Vuelta Abajo and is light to medium in strength. Its first large-gauge size, the Galanes at 52 x 120 mm, is one of its newer additions; it opens at once on creamy hazelnut and wood and stays smooth and creamy through most of the smoke.
